card.name: Route-of-administration words in dosing text
card.fires_on: Words naming the route of drug delivery, such as inhalation, transdermal, orally or subcutaneous injection, in dosage and administration sections. It often fires on the first part of the route word.

modes.label: Inhalation and transdermal
modes.description: Fires on the opening or middle part of inhalation or transdermal.

modes.label: Oral or injection route
modes.description: Fires on a route word that follows the verb administered.

card.writes: It seems to favor words that contrast or qualify, such as rather, based and 而不是, which hints at a route-versus-alternative contrast.
card.plain: It lights up on words that say how a drug is given, like inhaled, skin patch, oral or injection.
